source: Lacour et al. (2008), A&A 485, 561, Table 3, power-law limb darkening fitted to the IOTA/IONIC visibilities and closure phases of May 2006 (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361:200809611)
band: IOTA/IONIC H band, 1.5-1.8 um, seven channels fitted with one law; not a visible band
note: I(mu)/I(1) = mu^alpha, the paper's equation 3 (Hestroffer 1997). Fitted with the limb-darkened diameter 20.900 ± 0.007 mas at a reduced chi-squared of 1.962; the paper recommends the power law over its two-parameter fit, which does no better (1.959). The record's radius keeps the diameter of that two-parameter fit, 20.922 mas, 0.1% larger. The visible limb is not measured.
